name: Immortal Fruit Flies
description: Living fruit-fly brains on BNB Smart Chain. Each fly runs all 139,248 neurons of the FlyWire connectome in the published whole-brain model. Its brain state, memory, lineage and interaction history are committed to the FlyRegistry by whichever body is running it: an arena where it smells its way to food, DOOM where its escape reflex pulls the trigger, and any body anyone builds. It starves if nobody feeds it; a dead fly's brain is preserved on-chain and cannot be sold until someone resurrects it. Minting (1 $FLY), feeding, resurrecting and breeding burn $FLY. 10,000 flies at most.
